identification: Nine vintage Australian wooden explosives boxes (finger/dovetail jointed), most likely Nobel (Alfred Nobel / Nobel Australia) gelignite boxes of the 1950s-60s. Photo shows lettering consistent with 'BULK ... X' stencils; two box ends painted (green, patterned), one dark narrow box on top. Photo is low resolution (800x600) so maker roundels and wording cannot be read.

viewing_check: Read the maker roundels and end stencils on each box (Nobel, ICIANZ, Alfred Nobel, Deer Park), look for ones marked Powder or Detonators, check for lids, joints, rot and borer, and note which are painted over. Only the Nobel-branded unpainted boxes reach A$100+.
